slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total profit from producing and selling the three products?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total profit, directly covering the hidden objective slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 hidden slot (objective) was explicitly confirmed in turn 1 before the agent declared READY_TO_MODEL; the remaining questions about integrality, profit-rate interpretation, and extra constraints further clarified the model.

summary: The agent directly clarified the single hidden P0 slot (maximize profit) and asked sensible follow-up questions on integrality and the piecewise profit structure before declaring READY_TO_MODEL, resulting in a well-scoped stopping decision.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
